text:
All 10 tests now pass.

Fixed three bugs in `collkit.py`:
- `unique`: changed from `list(set(items))` to order-preserving de-duplication using a seen set.
- `partition`: swapped return order to `(yes, no)` so matches come first.
- `windows`: corrected range to `len(items) - k + 1` to include the final window.

Tests: 10 passed.
